messages:
maria: Heads-up — CI small-batch p99 jumped ~35% on runtime-staging after we rolled driver 561.22 to canary. Quick thread to triage.

devin: ugh. can you paste the numbers? which pipeline/bench?

maria: benchmark: tinyseq-infer (1-8 tokens, batch 1-8). before (driver 561.10): p50 12ms / p95 18ms / p99 28ms. after (561.22): p50 14ms / p95 26ms / p99 38ms. baseline run IDs: run_2026_03_18_01 and run_2026_03_18_02.

samir: I looked at profiler traces. kernel dispatch histogram shifted — we used to hit cuBLASLT matmul kernels for int8/FP16 paths, now a subset is falling back to a different matmul path (cublasGemmEx / custom fallback) which is slower at tiny batch/seq. snippet:
```
# sample dispatch events (shortened)
matmul_kernel: matmul_cublaslt_128x128  count=842 -> 220
matmul_kernel: matmul_cublas_fallback_v2  count=12 -> 640
```
this happened right after the driver rollout.

rachelle: Also seeing KV cache telemetry abnormality — evictions/sec jumped x3 on canary. suspect combined effect: slightly slower matmuls extend token timings -> prefetch/backpressure -> more aggressive eviction heuristics. logs: `kvcache.evictions: 322 -> 984`

maria: good call. nvprof/nvtx traces attached to the run show prefetch thread waiting on a cuBLAS event more often.

devin: did we change anything else in the same deploy window? triton or autotuner tweaks?

maria: there was that triton autotuner PR (platform/triton: prefer-heuristic-tiling) merged yesterday but it only affects >512 sequence runs AFAIK. can reproduce locally with just driver swap though.

samir: I did a quick local compare on an A100: driver 561.10 vs 561.22, same CUDA runtime. Repro steps: checkout main, run microbench tinyseq. Results: matmul median kernel time +18% on 561.22, and kernel selection log shows different algo IDs for small sizes. nvtx snippet:
```
# 561.10: cublaslt algo=3 (fast path)
# 561.22: cublaslt algo=7 -> falls back to slower kernel
```
forcing `REDWOOD_PREFER_CUBLASLT=1` pins to the old path and restores p99 near baseline in my repro.

maria: tried the env toggle on staging canary, p99 dropped back ~28ms. this suggests driver behavior change in algo ranking.

ci-bot: canary-rollout: paused — p99 threshold exceeded on runtime-staging (rule: tinyseq p99 > 30ms).

devin: can we do two things: (1) revert the driver rollout on infra side (fast rollback), (2) open a runtime-side mitigation to pin preferred kernel/path until we have a longer-term fix?

rachelle: agree. I'll open an incident and tag infra for driver rollback. Also adding a short-term runtime flag to prefer the cublaslt algorithm for small-tile matmuls.

maria: creating PR to expose `PREFER_CUBLASLT_SMALLTILE=1` and enable it on staging. If infra can rollback driver to 561.10, we can unpause canary quickly. Marking as rollout-blocker.

samir: filing perf bug and emailing vendor with the algo-ranking diffs + nvtx extracts. we should get a vendor confirmation if this is intentional.

devin: thanks — once PR is up ping me. if infra doesn't rollback in 30m we should hotpatch the runtime flag in canary.

maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood inference/runtime/pull/4823 (WIP). will post updates here. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
